      TEAM PLANS RELATED
      Per-seat or tiered? How to price a When to raise prices
                                        The case against free tiers
      team plan Annual billing, explained
      By Lena Ortiz · October 3, 2026 ·6 min read What a seat minimum signals
      Most teams choose between charging for every seat and charging by tier. Per-seat pricing
                                        Get one pricing note a week
      is easy to explain and grows with the customer, but it punishes the customers who invite
      the most colleagues. you@example.com
      Tiered pricing hides that penalty. A team of four and a team of nine pay the same, so
      nobody hesitates before adding a colleague. The cost is a harder first decision: which tier
      am I?
      A seat minimum is the usual compromise. Charge per seat, but start every team at three.
      Small teams get a predictable bill, and the price still follows growth after that.
      Whichever you choose, write the price down in one sentence. If the sentence needs the
      word "depending", the plan is not finished.
